description: EPA produced this national data set of sewer overflow and bypass events, which permittees submit electronically under the NPDES Electronic Reporting rule, and publishes it through ECHO as a zipped collection of CSV tables. The reports cover anticipated and unanticipated bypasses at treatment plants, wet-weather combined sewer overflows that endanger health or the environment, dry-weather discharges from combined systems and sanitary sewer overflows. ECHO's Water Pollutant Loading Tool adds discharge monitoring report and permit data from ICIS-NPDES for facilities in all 50 states and US territories and tribes, and TRI wastewater discharge data since 2007. Coverage is the United States. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Public domain (EPA web policy: EPA-produced data are in the public domain unless otherwise specified). Caveats: EPA states the overflow data set is in development and does not yet hold all events covered by the eRule, because states are still implementing Phase 2 of electronic reporting. Simulation uses: overflow and bypass event histories for wastewater and drainage capacity, flood and failure studies. Related records: the Clean Watersheds Needs Survey (data-epa-clean-watersheds-needs-survey-2022) and England's storm overflow returns (data-ea-edm-storm-overflows-annual-returns).
